task.description:
WF-03 Step 4 — TEST-DESIGNER write regression tests for ISS-0123 fix.

Read the design at src/design/dlq_rename_and_trigger_isolation.md. The design specifies two regression tests:

  Test 1 — Source-assertion regression for Cluster B. The test fails if any dead_letter_queue literal returns to src/ or tests/integration/. Pattern: read each file as text and assert no occurrence. Equivalent to the new tools/lint_sql_table_refs.py linter, but as a runnable integration test that ties to the platform's test suite.

  Test 2 — Audit-insert smoke for Cluster A. After running tests/integration/obs05_dlq_test.zig (which intentionally trips trg_bpm_test_fail_audit_insert), the next test (or a final assertion in obs05) must verify that the trigger was properly cleaned up by attempting a normal audit insert. With the savepoint fix, the cleanup is unconditional, so a normal audit insert MUST succeed after obs05 runs.

  Test 3 (optional) — End-to-end: in tests/integration/iss202_merge_atomicity_test.zig and iss203_idempotency_keys_test.zig, the original P0001 + C42703 errors should not appear. Add a sanity check at the start of each test that no P0001 has been raised in the current session.

Required actions:
1. Read docs/guides/test_developer_guide.md for the integration test patterns.
2. Write the test spec at tests/specs/ISS-0123-regression.md (YAML or markdown spec).
3. Write the test source file at tests/integration/iss0123_regression_test.zig. The test should:
   - Cluster B source-assertion: scan src/**/*.zig and tests/integration/**/*.zig for any "dead_letter_queue" string and assert count == 0 (or fail with the list of files)
   - Cluster A audit-insert smoke: connect to BPM_TEST_DB_URL, attempt a normal INSERT INTO audit_entries ...; expect success
   - Use per-test UUIDs for any rows inserted (test isolation rule)
   - Clean up after itself (delete inserted rows)
4. Make the test self-sufficient: if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is not set, fail clearly with "test infrastructure unavailable".
5. NO mocks, NO stubs (per DIRECTIVE T-1/T-2).
6. NO error.SkipZigTest on this test (it is a MUST for ISS-0123 closure).
7. The test must connect to the real PostgreSQL via BPM_TEST_DB_URL.
8. Run `python3 tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration/iss0123_regression_test.zig` to confirm isolation (if the linter exists).

The fix and the new linter are already in place. The new test verifies the fix at the test level (i.e. that the schema-vs-test drift is gone, not just that the linter is happy).
acceptance_criteria: Test scans for dead_letter_queue literals in src/ and tests/integration/ and asserts 0 hits
Test runs a normal audit-insert after obs05 setup and asserts success
Test uses per-test UUIDs for any rows
Test fails clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is unset

result.summary: Wrote regression test for ISS-0123 covering both failure clusters: TC-ISS-0123-01 (Cluster B source-assertion: scans src/ and tests/integration/ for any `dead_letter_queue` literal and fails with the list of `path:line` hits if count > 0) and TC-ISS-0123-02 (Cluster A audit-insert smoke: opens a TestHarness transaction and issues a normal INSERT INTO audit_entries with a per-test UUID for resource_id). Per-test UUIDs, defer h.deinit() rollback cleanup, no mocks, no stubs, no error.SkipZigTest. tools/lint_test_isolation.py reports clean (0 issues). zig ast-check parses the file without errors.
